components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action of a region, as a physical piece of gold.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 500 13px/18px var(--font-sans, 'Archboard Onest', sans-serif); color: var(--primary-foreground); background-color: var(--primary-bottom); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary-top), var(--primary-bottom)); border: 1px solid var(--primary-edge); border-radius: 3px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; box-shadow: var(--elevation-primary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary-top), white 16%), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary-bottom), white 9%)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary-bottom), black 4%), var(--primary-top)); box-shadow: var(--elevation-primary-pressed); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action, raised off the surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font: 500 13px/18px var(--font-sans, 'Archboard Onest', sans-serif); color: var(--foreground); background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; box-shadow: var(--elevation-raised); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { box-shadow: var(--elevation-pressed); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Go Deeper Row
components.description: The primary way down from a picked part, at the foot of the details panel.
components.css: .ds-go { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 280px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; text-align: left; color: var(--primary-foreground); background-color: var(--primary-bottom); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary-top), var(--primary-bottom)); border: 1px solid var(--primary-edge); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: var(--elevation-primary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-go:hover { background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary-top), white 16%), color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary-bottom), white 9%)); } .ds-go:active { box-shadow: var(--elevation-primary-pressed); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-go-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-go-title { font: 600 13px/18px var(--font-sans, 'Archboard Onest', sans-serif); } .ds-go-sub { font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-sans, 'Archboard Onest', sans-serif); opacity: 0.75; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A field sunk into its surface.
components.css: .ds-field { font: 400 13px/18px var(--font-sans, 'Archboard Onest', sans-serif); color: var(--foreground); background: var(--background); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 3px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; box-shadow: var(--elevation-well); outline: none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); }

components.name: Navigator Row
components.description: The chosen row of the navigator, raised as a plate with a gold bar.
components.html:
Agent workbench
Archboard server
Browser application
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 300px; padding: 4px; background: var(--sidebar); } .ds-nav-row { position: relative; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-sans, 'Archboard Onest', sans-serif); color: var(--sidebar-foreground); border-radius: 3px; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-accent) 50%, transparent); } .ds-nav-chosen { background: var(--sidebar-accent); box-shadow: var(--elevation-raised); } .ds-nav-chosen::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--primary-text); }

narrative.overview:
The picture is a drawing that lies flat on a table. The shell is the furniture around it: rails, a header under the lamp, a tray at the foot of each column and a few pieces of gold hardware. An agent drew the picture, and the architect reads it. Nothing in the shell competes with the picture for attention, and nothing in the shell paints on it.

The shell is dense desktop chrome at 1920×1080. It uses 13px controls, 28px rows and small corners. Its neutrals are warm graphite and chalk, tinted toward the hue of the gold. Depth comes from planes, not from lines. The chrome stands on the picture and casts a short, warm, still shadow onto it. Controls stand on the chrome with a highlight on their top edge. Menus and dialogs float above everything. One warm yellow-gold marks what is chosen. It also marks the one primary action of a region, and that action is drawn as a physical piece of gold.
keyCharacteristics: The picture is the ground. The shell sits around it and over it.
Planes stack under a light from above. Each plane has a tone step, a highlight on its top edge and a warm shadow with an offset.
One gold has three uses: what is chosen, the one primary action, and the voice and the brand mark.
Tall condensed capitals set a name as a title. Plain sans sets every other word. Mono sets technical tokens only.
The shell is for the desktop only, near full screen at 1920×1080.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks what is chosen, the one primary action of a region, and the voice and the brand mark. Nothing else is gold.

rules.name: The Untouched Picture Rule
rules.body: The renderer draws the picture. The shell never paints gold, shadow or decoration on a card in it.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Mono sets technical tokens only. It never sets a label or a heading.

rules.name: The Still Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow over the picture is a static box-shadow. Nothing over the picture viewport uses backdrop-filter, filter, blur or animation.

rules.name: The Planes Not Lines Rule
rules.body: Regions read as layered planes. A one-pixel rule stays only where it draws the edge of a control or a card, or where it divides regions on one plane.

dos: Do draw the one primary action of a region with `primary-finish`, and only that one.
Do separate regions with tone steps and elevation tokens before you add a rule.
Do keep shadows warm and offset. Take them from the elevation tokens in palette.css.
Do keep the ink on gold at Gold Ink (at least 8.5:1).
donts: Do not put backdrop-filter, filter, blur or animation over the picture viewport.
Do not paint gold or decoration onto a card in the picture.
Do not use a grey-black blur or a halo without an offset as a shadow.
Do not add a phone or narrow layout.
Do not set a label or a heading in mono.
